App.title: Electronic tax return
App.headline: Tax return for self-employed persons with flat-rate expenses (DPFO type B)

Home.preparedWith: Prepared in cooperation with tax advisors from <link>AVENIAS Tax & Legal</link>
Home.workingOnVersion: We are working on the current version.
Home.introLive: Fill in your tax return quickly and easily.
Home.introNotLive: You will be able to prepare your tax return quickly and easily in {year} as well.
Home.introDownload: After entering some basic details, you can download your prepared tax return. We will then guide you through submitting it on the Financial Administration (Finančná správa) website.
Home.introPurpose: The app is intended for filing a regular or corrective tax return by self-employed persons (SZČO) working physically in Slovakia and claiming flat-rate expenses.
Home.introVolunteers: The project was created by a group of volunteers and tax advisors who update the guide and the app every year.
Home.unsupportedHeading: We do not support these cases yet:
Home.unsupportedOtherIncome: Income other than from self-employment, employment and property rental
Home.unsupportedForeignIncome: Foreign income (except self-employment income from providing services)
Home.unsupportedWithholding: Income settled by withholding tax (e.g. dividends, author royalties)
Home.consentTaxForm: By using this service, you agree to the processing of your personal data to the extent necessary to generate the tax return. We do not store your data; it is used solely to prepare the tax return.
Home.startTaxForm: I agree and want to prepare my tax return
Home.notifyMe: Notify me when the app is ready
Home.postponeHeading: Extend the deadline for tax year {year}
Home.postponeUntilSlovakOnly: until 30.6.{year} if you only had income from Slovakia, or
Home.postponeUntilForeign: until 30.9.{year} if you also had foreign income
Home.consentPostpone: By using this service, you agree to the processing of your personal data to the extent necessary to generate the deadline extension. We do not store your data; it is used solely to prepare the deadline extension.
